Keep the stance low. The elbow strikes at the level of your own chest.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Step in, turn, strike
exercises.tip: The elbow travels a short way; the turn supplies the power.

exercises.name: Shoulder Strike · Kao
exercises.description: Step deep, sink and burst forward with the shoulder while the other hand guards the face. Shoulder strike is the closest-range gate.
steps: Step in deep, sink low and strike with the shoulder.
The shoulder does not swing. The legs drive the whole torso forward as one block.
Guard your face with the other hand.
The last of the eight gates. Now no distance leaves you helpless.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Step deep, sink, burst
exercises.tip: The legs drive the torso as one block; the shoulder never swings.

exercises.name: Fa Jin Palm Strike
exercises.description: Relax completely, then release a sudden palm strike from the legs and waist, and relax again. Fa jin trains explosive power without tension.
steps: Relax first. Then release the palm in one sharp instant.
The explosion lasts a fraction of a second. Before and after, you are soft.
Snap the waist and the back heel at the same time. The palm is only the messenger.
Tension is slow. Relaxation is fast. Stay loose until impact.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Relax, explode, relax
exercises.tip: Snap the waist and back heel together; the palm only delivers it.

exercises.name: Hidden-Hand Punch
exercises.description: Coil the waist with the fist at the hip, then uncoil the whole body behind one straight punch as the opposite elbow drives back. The hidden-hand punch is Chen-style power at its purest.
steps: Wide stance. Coil the waist, then fire.
The opposite elbow drives back as the fist drives forward. Two directions, double power.
Exhale sharply at the moment of the strike, then relax at once.
Coil slowly, release fast. The spring stores what the punch will spend.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Coil, then uncoil
exercises.tip: Coil slowly, release fast, relax instantly.

exercises.name: Pounding the Mortar
exercises.description: Raise knee and fist together, then stamp down as the fist drops into the palm and the body sinks. Pounding the mortar drives power into the ground.
steps: Lift the knee and fist together, then stamp and sink.
Stamp from the hip, not from the knee. The sound should be heavy, not sharp.
At the stamp, the whole body sinks. Feel the ground answer you.
This is rooting power. You are driving your weight into the earth.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Rise, stamp, sink
exercises.tip: Stamp from the hip; the sound should be heavy, not sharp.

exercises.name: Shaking Power
exercises.description: Stay loose, then release a sudden whole-body shudder from the legs to the fingertips and be still again. Dou Jin teaches the body to issue force as one piece.
steps: Loosen everything. Then shake it out in one burst.
The shake starts in the legs. If only the arms shake, it is not yet whole-body power.
Instant stillness afterwards. The pause is as important as the burst.
Feel the shock wave travel up the spine and out of the hands.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Loose, shudder, still
exercises.tip: The shake starts in the legs; if only the arms shake, slow down.

exercises.name: Combat Parry and Punch
exercises.description: Deflect with the fist, parry with the palm and step in with a straight punch at real speed. Defence and attack become one motion.
steps: Step, deflect, parry, punch.
The parry clears the line. The punch fills it. No pause between them.
Punch with a vertical fist at chest height, the shoulder relaxed.
Speed comes from relaxation. Tight muscles are slow muscles.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Deflect, parry, strike
exercises.tip: No pause between parry and punch.

exercises.name: Single Whip with Power
exercises.description: Anchor the hook hand, step wide and strike out with the palm in a sharp burst. Single whip with power shows the martial edge of a classic form.
steps: Form the hook, step wide, and strike with the palm.
Hook and palm stretch apart like a bow being drawn.
The strike lands as the front foot settles. Hand and foot arrive together.
Hold the posture for a breath. Wide, low and alive.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Hook, step, strike
exercises.tip: Hand and front foot arrive together.

exercises.name: Single-Hand Push Hands
exercises.description: In a bow stance, one forearm travels a smooth path as if stuck to a partner's arm, yielding and returning. Push hands builds sensitivity, the fighter's sixth sense.
steps: Bow stance, forearm forward. Draw the circle with your weight.
Sit back as the arm draws in, shift forward as it extends. The legs drive the circle.
Imagine a partner's arm. Never lose contact, never push against it.
Listen through the forearm. A fighter feels the intention before the attack.
exercises.breath: Inhale to yield, exhale to return
exercises.cue: Stick and follow
exercises.tip: Never lose contact with the imaginary arm; never push against it.

exercises.name: Four-Gate Push Hands
exercises.description: Flow through ward off, roll back, press and push in one unbroken loop. Four-gate push hands is the heart of Tai Chi combat training.
steps: Begin with ward off and let the loop roll.
No corners between the gates. One flows into the next like water.
Ward off receives, roll back leads, press closes, push releases.
Your weight shifts front and back, but your head stays at one level.
exercises.breath: Inhale to receive, exhale to issue
exercises.cue: Peng, Lu, Ji, An
exercises.tip: No corners between the gates; one flows into the next.

exercises.name: Advance and Retreat Steps
exercises.description: Glide forward heel to toe into low bow stances, then retreat without rising, the guard arm up. Footwork lets you control distance.
steps: Advance two steps, retreat two steps. Silent feet.
Step like a cat on thin ice. Place the foot, then transfer the weight.
Your head stays at the same height. Bobbing tells your opponent everything.
The guard arm never drops while the feet move.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Glide, never bob
exercises.tip: Place the foot first, then transfer the weight.

exercises.name: Separate-Foot Kick
exercises.description: Cross the wrists, chamber the knee, then snap the foot out at waist height as the arms split open. A kick built on balance and timing.
steps: Cross the wrists, lift the knee, and snap the kick out.
Lift the knee first, then extend. A kick without a chamber is only a swing.
Hands and foot open at the same moment.
Hold the balance for one breath after each kick before you place the foot.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Cross, lift, snap
exercises.tip: Lift the knee first, then extend.

exercises.name: Power Heel Kick
exercises.description: Chamber the knee high, then thrust the heel forward from the hip as the arms open. The strongest kick in Tai Chi.
steps: Knee high, then drive the heel forward.
Strike with the heel, toes pulled back. The heel carries the power.
The standing leg is rooted and slightly bent. The body leans neither forward nor back.
Control on the way out, control on the way back. No falling into the step.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Chamber, thrust, hold
exercises.tip: Strike with the heel, toes pulled back, body upright.

exercises.name: Snake to Golden Rooster
exercises.description: Drop into a very low stance along the floor, then rise explosively onto one leg with the knee driving up. Strength from the lowest point to the highest.
steps: Sink as low as you can control, then rise and drive the knee.
Go only as low as you can rise from without using your hands.
The rise is one explosive motion: shift, stand, knee, palm.
Low to high in one breath. This is the fighter's escape and counter.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Drop low, rise like a spring
exercises.tip: Go only as low as you can rise from without using your hands.

exercises.name: Needle and Fan
exercises.description: Plunge the fingertips down like a needle, then rise and step forward as the palm thrusts out and the other hand guards high. Pull down and strike through in one flow.
steps: Sit back and plunge, then rise and thrust.
Fold from the hips, back long. The needle goes down, the eyes stay forward.
Rise and step in one motion. The front palm and front foot arrive together.
The high hand is your shield. Never leave the head open.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Plunge, rise, thrust
exercises.tip: Fold from the hips with a long back; eyes stay forward.

exercises.name: Combat Flow
exercises.description: Parry, palm strike, elbow and shoulder flow into one continuous attack, each closer than the last. Combat flow is where the techniques become fighting.
steps: Flow through the four techniques without a single pause.
Each technique steps closer. Hand range, elbow range, shoulder range.
No pause between strikes. Each one sets up the next.
Breathe out on every strike and stay low from start to finish.
exercises.breath: Exhale on the release, inhale to gather
exercises.cue: Parry, palm, elbow, shoulder
exercises.tip: Breathe out on every strike and stay low throughout.

exercises.name: Dantian Breathing
exercises.description: Rest the palms on the lower belly and breathe slowly and deeply with soft knees. Dantian breathing settles the body and gathers the energy of training.
steps: Palms on the belly. Breathe low and slow.
Breathe in through the nose and let the belly expand into your palms.
Breathe out slowly. Let the shoulders, the chest and the mind settle.
Gather the energy of today's training below the navel. Keep it there.
exercises.breath: Inhale to fill, exhale to settle
exercises.cue: Gather everything below the navel
exercises.tip: Let the belly move, not the shoulders.

exercises.name: Skater Steps
exercises.description: Glide from side to side like a speed skater, landing softly on one foot while the other sweeps behind you. A low-impact way to raise your heart rate and wake up the outer hips.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Step or hop lightly to the right and land on your right foot.
Let your left foot sweep behind you as your arms swing across.
Push off gently and glide back to the left, landing on your left foot.
Keep moving side to side in a smooth, easy rhythm.
exercises.breath: Breathe out as you land on each side
exercises.cue: Land softly, glide side to side
exercises.tip: Keep it a step, not a jump, whenever you want less impact.

exercises.name: Low-Impact Jacks
exercises.description: All the rhythm of a jumping jack without the jump: step one foot out wide as both arms sweep overhead, then step back in. Easy on the joints and great for warming the whole body.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Step one foot out wide as both arms sweep up overhead.
Step the foot back in as your arms float down.
Keep stepping out and in with a brisk, steady beat.
exercises.breath: Inhale as the arms rise · exhale as they lower
exercises.cue: Step wide, arms high
exercises.tip: Let your arms stay long and relaxed rather than locking the elbows.

exercises.name: Overhead Press March
exercises.description: A lively march in place with both arms pressing up to the sky and pulling back down. It brings the upper body into your walk and lifts your heart rate.
steps: Stand tall and begin marching in place.
Bring your hands up beside your shoulders.
Press both arms overhead as you keep marching.
Pull the elbows back down to shoulder height and press up again.
exercises.breath: Breathe out as your arms press up
exercises.cue: March and press to the sky
exercises.tip: Keep your ribs down and your core gently firm as the arms rise.

exercises.name: Lunge and Knee Lift Reach
exercises.description: A flowing standing combo: step back into a shallow lunge with the arms overhead, open the arms wide as you return, then lift a knee as you reach up again. It works the legs, balance and shoulders together.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back into a shallow lunge as both arms reach overhead.
Return to standing as your arms open wide to the sides.
Lift one knee as both arms reach overhead again.
Lower the foot, open the arms, and repeat the combo.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you reach · exhale as you return
exercises.cue: Lunge, open, knee up
exercises.tip: Keep the lunge shallow and lift the knee only as high as feels steady.

exercises.name: Step-Out Squat Right
exercises.description: Step your right foot out wide into a shallow squat, then rise and step back in. Strengthens the thighs and glutes while keeping your walking rhythm.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together and hands at your chest.
Step your right foot out wide.
Sit your hips back into a shallow squat, chest lifted.
Press up and step your right foot back in.
Repeat on the same side.
exercises.breath: Exhale as you press up
exercises.cue: Step out, sit back, rise
exercises.tip: Keep your weight in your heels and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Step-Out Squat Left
exercises.description: Step your left foot out wide into a shallow squat, then rise and step back in. Strengthens the thighs and glutes while keeping your walking rhythm.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together and hands at your chest.
Step your left foot out wide.
Sit your hips back into a shallow squat, chest lifted.
Press up and step your left foot back in.
Repeat on the same side.
exercises.breath: Exhale as you press up
exercises.cue: Step out, sit back, rise
exercises.tip: Keep your weight in your heels and your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Seated Jacks
exercises.description: A jumping jack you can do from your chair: tap both feet out wide as the arms sweep overhead, then bring everything back in. Quick, cheerful cardio with no impact.
steps: Sit near the front of the chair, feet together, arms by your sides.
Tap both feet out wide as your arms sweep up overhead.
Bring the feet back together as the arms come down.
Keep a brisk, steady rhythm.
exercises.breath: Keep breathing with the rhythm · never hold your breath
exercises.cue: Feet wide, arms high
exercises.tip: Hold the sides of the seat with one hand if you need more support.

exercises.name: Seated Wood Chop
exercises.description: Swing your clasped hands high overhead, then chop them down toward your knees. A powerful seated move that works the core, shoulders and breath together.
steps: Sit tall near the front of the chair, feet flat and wide.
Clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
Swing them up high overhead as you lengthen your spine.
Chop them down toward your knees, hinging slightly forward.
Rise and repeat with a steady, energetic rhythm.
exercises.breath: Inhale up · exhale on the chop
exercises.cue: Reach high, chop down
exercises.tip: Keep your back long as you chop; hinge from the hips, not the neck.

exercises.name: Press and Knee Lift
exercises.description: Press both arms overhead as one knee lifts, then lower them together. It combines an upper-body press with a seated march for a full-body effort.
steps: Sit tall with your hands beside your shoulders.
Press both arms overhead as you lift one knee.
Lower the arms and the foot together.
Repeat at a steady pace, keeping your spine tall.
exercises.breath: Exhale as you press and lift
exercises.cue: Press up, knee up
exercises.tip: Lift the knee only as high as you can while staying tall.

exercises.name: Side Reach and Tap Right
exercises.description: Sweep your right arm up and over your head as your right leg slides out to the side. A long stretch through the side body with a little cardio rhythm.
steps: Sit tall near the front of the chair, feet flat.
Slide your right leg out to the side.
Sweep your right arm up and over your head, bending gently to the left.
Return to centre, bringing the arm and leg back in.
Repeat on the same side with a smooth rhythm.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you reach · exhale to return
exercises.cue: Reach long, tap wide
exercises.tip: Keep both sitting bones heavy on the chair as you bend.

exercises.name: Side Reach and Tap Left
exercises.description: Sweep your left arm up and over your head as your left leg slides out to the side. A long stretch through the side body with a little cardio rhythm.
steps: Sit tall near the front of the chair, feet flat.
Slide your left leg out to the side.
Sweep your left arm up and over your head, bending gently to the right.
Return to centre, bringing the arm and leg back in.
Repeat on the same side with a smooth rhythm.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you reach · exhale to return
exercises.cue: Reach long, tap wide
exercises.tip: Keep both sitting bones heavy on the chair as you bend.

exercises.name: Wall Glute Kickbacks
exercises.description: With your hands on the wall for support, press one leg back and up behind you, then lower it. A simple, effective way to wake up and shape the glutes.
steps: Stand facing the wall with both palms on it at chest height.
Lean in slightly and firm your core.
Press one leg back and up behind you, squeezing the glute.
Lower the foot back down beside the other.
Repeat with the other leg, keeping your hips square to the wall.
exercises.breath: Exhale as the leg presses back
exercises.cue: Press back, squeeze, lower
exercises.tip: Lift only as high as you can without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Standing Wall Climbers
exercises.description: A standing version of mountain climbers: lean into the wall and drive your knees toward it one after the other. Quick cardio that also works the core.
steps: Stand facing the wall with your palms on it at chest height.
Walk your feet back a little so your body leans in.
Drive your right knee up toward the wall, then return the foot.
Drive your left knee up toward the wall.
Keep alternating in a brisk, springy rhythm.
exercises.breath: Breathe steadily with the rhythm
exercises.cue: Lean in, drive the knees
exercises.tip: Slow the pace if your shoulders start to lift toward your ears.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up Knee Drive
exercises.description: A wall push-up followed by a knee drive. It strengthens the chest and arms, then adds a balance and core challenge.
steps: Stand facing the wall with your palms on it at chest height.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the wall.
Press back out to straight arms.
Drive one knee up toward your chest, then lower it.
Do another push-up and drive the other knee.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you lower · exhale as you press
exercises.cue: Push, press, knee up
exercises.tip: Keep your body in one straight line during each push-up.

exercises.name: Wall Slide Squat Reach
exercises.description: With your back on the wall, slide down into a small squat as both arms slide overhead, then rise as the arms lower. Legs and posture work together.
steps: Stand with your back and head against the wall, feet a step forward.
Bring your arms up against the wall at shoulder height.
Slide down into a small squat as your arms slide overhead.
Press through your heels to slide back up as the arms lower.
Repeat slowly, keeping your back on the wall.
exercises.breath: Inhale as you slide down · exhale to rise
exercises.cue: Slide down, reach up
exercises.tip: Only go as low as feels comfortable for your knees.
