plans.title: 30-Day Tai Chi Journey
plans.subtitle: 30 days · the full 24-form, two new skills a day
plans.description: Your main Tai Chi path. In 30 days you learn the complete Yang 24-form, the sequence practised in parks around the world, in its true order. Every day your tutor welcomes you and teaches two new skills: you watch each movement first, then practise it once, at an unhurried pace. Each lesson recalls the forms you learned most recently, milestone days run whole sections, and the last ten days add the essentials masters practise for a lifetime. On day 30 you move through all 24 forms. Days 1 and 2 are free.

days.title: The beginning · your first two forms

items.wl: Lifting the Sky. The hands rise with the in-breath, and float down with the out-breath.
items.go: Your turn. Interlace your fingers in front of your belly.

c.l: Breathe in, and lift all the way overhead, palms to the sky.
Breathe out, and let your arms float down. A little taller with every breath.

items.wl: Painting a Rainbow. Watch how the arm sweeps overhead, and the weight follows it from side to side.
items.go: Your turn. Feet wide, knees soft.

c.l: Let one arm arc overhead, like painting the sky. The legs move first.
Breathe in as you rise, out as you arrive.

items.wl: Your root. Feet shoulder-width, knees soft, spine tall. Every Tai Chi form grows from this stance.
items.go: Sink a little into your legs.

c.l: Rock gently forward and back, then find the still point in the middle.
Imagine roots growing from your feet. Shoulders heavy, the crown of your head light.

items.wl: Holding the Ball. One hand above, one below, as if hugging a ball. The waist turns, and the ball travels.
items.go: This is the first half of Wild Horse's Mane, so feel it well.

c.l: Shift your weight, and let the waist turn the ball. The hands never lead.
Stay low and soft.

items.wl: Your first form: the Opening Form. Watch how the arms float up to shoulder height, then the knees soften as the palms press down.
items.go: Slowly, with me.

c.l: Arms float forward, wrists soft, only up to shoulder height.
Now sink. The knees bend as the palms press down, like pressing a ball under water.
Arms rise while the body stays tall. Hands lower as the knees bend. Arms and legs, together.
Breathe in, and let the breath float your arms up.
Never rush the breath to catch the arms. Breath and movement are one.

u.l: Opening Form, learned. That's one of twenty-four.

items.wl: The Tai Chi step. Watch the heel touch down first, still empty, and only then the weight rolls forward.
items.go: Like stepping onto thin ice.

c.l: Heel first. Test the ground. Then shift your weight forward.
Shift back, and step again. Slow, quiet feet.

items.wl: Your second form: Parting the Wild Horse's Mane. Watch: hold the ball, step out heel first, then the hands part, one up, one down, as the weight moves forward.
items.go: One side at a time, slowly.

c.l: Hold the ball on your right. Step out to the left, heel first.
Turn your waist, and part the hands. The left hand rises to eye level, the right presses down by your hip.
Now hold the ball on the other side, and repeat. The waist first, the hands follow.
Front knee over the toes, never past them. Back leg long, but soft.
In, hold the ball. Out, step and part.
Keep your height level. No bobbing up and down.

u.l: Wild Horse's Mane, learned. Two of twenty-four.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Welcome. I'm so happy you're here.
Over the next thirty days, you'll learn all twenty-four forms of Tai Chi, and move just like this.
Not with force, but with breath, balance and calm.
Today, you'll learn your first two forms.
Before every movement, you'll watch me first. Then it's your turn.
Wonderful. Day one is complete.
You found your root, and learned your first two Tai Chi forms.
That's two of twenty-four, already.
Tomorrow, you'll learn White Crane Spreads Its Wings, and Brush Knee.
I'll see you then.

items.wl: Squat Swing. Watch the knees bend as the arms swing back, then the body rises onto the toes as the arms swing forward.
items.go: Your turn. Easy and rhythmic.

c.l: Sink and swing back. Rise and swing forward.
Let the legs do the work, and let the arms ride along. Feel the warmth building.

items.wl: Broadening the Chest. Watch the arms rise in front, then open wide like unfolding wings.
items.go: Your turn. Open, and breathe.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open wide. Feel the chest expand.
Breathe out as the arms close and float down.

items.go: Opening Form. Rise with the in-breath, sink with the out-breath.
Wild Horse's Mane. Hold the ball, step, and part.

items.wl: White Crane Spreads Its Wings. Watch the weight sit fully on the back leg while the front toes barely touch. One hand rises beside the head, the other settles by the hip.
items.go: Sit back first, then let the wings open.

c.l: Shift all your weight onto the back leg. The front foot is empty, toes resting lightly.
The right hand rises to the side of your forehead. The left hand presses down beside the hip.
Lift through the crown of the head. Shoulders stay down, chest soft.
Breathe in, and gather the hands as if holding a ball.
Stay light on the front toes, like a bird about to fly.

u.l: White Crane, learned. Three of twenty-four.

items.wl: The Tai Chi step on the other side. Watch the front foot receive the weight slowly, then send it back.
items.go: Heel first, then roll forward.

c.l: Rock forward onto the front foot, then sit back.
Slow, quiet feet. Today's forms step forward like this.

items.wl: Brush Knee and Twist Step. Watch one hand brush past the knee as you step forward, while the other hand pushes out from beside the ear.
items.go: Step first, then brush and push.

c.l: Turn the waist, and bring the right hand up beside your ear.
Step forward, heel first. The left hand brushes across, past the front knee.
Shift forward and push the right palm out at chest height. Hand and foot arrive together.
In, turn and draw the hand back. Out, step, brush and push.
Push from the legs, not the shoulder. The arm only delivers.

u.l: Brush Knee, learned. Four of twenty-four.

items.wl: Opening the Lungs. Watch the arms push out and draw in, opening the chest like a gentle accordion.
items.go: Slow, full breaths.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open. Breathe out as they push away.
Let each breath be a little deeper than the last.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Welcome back. Yesterday you learned your first two forms.
Today's two skills: White Crane Spreads Its Wings, and Brush Knee and Twist Step.
Before every movement, watch first. Then it's your turn.
Beautiful work. Four forms already.
That's four of twenty-four.
Tomorrow: Empty and full, and Play the Lute. I'll see you then.

days.title: Empty and full · Play the Lute

items.wl: Rowing the Boat. Watch the arms circle down, back and up, as the body bends gently forward and rises.
items.go: Your turn. Long, slow strokes.

c.l: Bend the knees as the arms row down and back.
Rise and circle the arms up. Row the whole lake with every stroke.

items.wl: Spinning Wheel. Watch the arms trace a great circle down one side, across the legs, and up overhead.
items.go: Your turn. A big, slow wheel.

c.l: Let the weight travel with the circle, from foot to foot.
Keep the circle round and unhurried. Then change direction.

items.go: White Crane. Sit back, and spread the wings.
Brush Knee. Brush past the knee, push from the legs.

items.wl: A core Tai Chi skill: empty and full. Watch the weight move slowly from one leg to the other, while the body stays level.
items.go: Feet wide, knees soft. Shift slowly.

c.l: Move all your weight into the right leg. The left foot becomes empty, but stays on the floor.
Now pour the weight slowly across, like water from one cup into another.
Notice the moment both legs share the weight. Don't stop there. Keep pouring.
Out, arrive fully on one leg. In, travel back through the middle.
Every Tai Chi form is built on this. One leg full, one leg empty.

u.l: Empty and full. A core Tai Chi skill, unlocked.

items.wl: Play the Lute. Watch the back leg take the weight, the front heel touch down lightly, and the hands come together as if holding a lute.
items.go: Sit back, then raise the lute.

c.l: Sit back onto the right leg. Place the left heel down, toes up.
The left hand rises in front at nose height, the right hand near the left elbow, like holding a lute.
Sink into the back leg. The front leg stays empty and light.
In, sit back. Out, place the heel and close the hands.
Hold the shape for a breath. Feel the root in the back leg.

u.l: Play the Lute, learned. Five of twenty-four.

items.wl: Side Stretch. Watch the body grow tall first, then arc gently to the side.
items.go: Tall first, then arc.

c.l: Reach up, and lean softly to one side. Breathe into the stretch.
Come back through the centre, and stretch the other side.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: Day three. Today we go deeper into how Tai Chi moves.
Today's two skills: Empty and full, and Play the Lute.
Empty and full is the secret behind every form you'll ever learn.
Wonderful. You learned the secret of empty and full, and a new form.
Five of twenty-four forms.
Tomorrow: Stepping back, and Repulse the Monkey. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Twisting Arm Swings. Watch the waist turn and the arms swing loosely around the body, like empty sleeves in the wind.
items.go: Your turn. Loose arms, easy turns.

c.l: Turn from the waist, and let the arms wrap around you.
Let the heels lift a little as you turn. Loosen everything.

items.wl: Pushing Waves. Watch the weight rock forward and back as the palms push out and draw in, like a wave.
items.go: Your turn. Ride the wave.

c.l: Push forward as the weight goes forward. Draw back as it returns.
The movement starts in the legs. The hands are just the crest of the wave.

items.wl: Next skill: stepping back. Watch the foot reach back and touch down with the toes first, before the weight follows.
items.go: Small steps, toes first.

c.l: Lift one foot and reach it back, quietly. Touch down with the toes.
Only when the foot is planted, let your weight roll back into it.
Keep the feet on two separate tracks, hip-width apart, never on one line.
Breathe in as you lift and reach back. Breathe out as the weight settles.
This is the footwork of Repulse the Monkey. Calm, controlled, never rushed.

u.l: Stepping back with control. Skill unlocked.

items.go: Opening Form. Rise with the in-breath, sink with the out-breath.
Wild Horse's Mane. Hold the ball, step, and part.
White Crane. Sit back, and spread the wings.
Brush Knee. Brush past the knee, push from the legs.
Play the Lute. Sit back, heel down, hold the lute.

items.wl: Repulse the Monkey. Watch one arm circle back and up beside the ear as the foot steps back, then the palm pushes forward while the other hand draws back to the hip.
items.go: One step back at a time.

c.l: Turn the waist, and let the right hand drop back and circle up beside your ear.
Step back with the left foot, toes first, and shift your weight back onto it.
As you sink back, the right palm pushes forward and the left hand draws back to the hip.
In, the hand circles up. Out, step back and push.
Keep your height level. Retreat like a calm tide, never a stumble.

u.l: Repulse the Monkey, learned. Six of twenty-four. Section one is complete.

items.wl: Qi Ball. Watch the hands hold a light, floating sphere, the palms gently drawing apart and together.
items.go: Hold the ball of energy.

c.l: Draw the hands apart slowly, then bring them closer.
Notice any warmth or tingling between the palms. That is your Qi.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Day four. Today, section one comes together.
Today's two skills: Stepping back, and Repulse the Monkey.
By the end of today, you'll flow through all six forms of section one.
Section one is complete. Six forms, flowing as one.
That's a real milestone: a quarter of the whole form.
Tomorrow: Roll back, and Grasp the Bird's Tail. I'll see you then.

days.title: Roll back · Grasp the Bird's Tail

items.wl: Bouncing the Ball. Watch one knee lift as the opposite hand rises, as if bouncing an imaginary ball.
items.go: Your turn. Light and springy.

c.l: Lift the knee, and let the hand float up with it.
Change sides. Soft bounces, steady balance.

items.wl: Cloud Hands in Horse Stance. Watch the legs stay rooted while the hands drift side to side like clouds.
items.go: Your turn. Sink into a horse stance.

c.l: Let the waist turn the hands from side to side.
Stay low and steady. The legs warm up while the arms float.

items.go: Play the Lute. Sit back, heel down, hold the lute.
Repulse the Monkey. Step back, and push.

items.wl: A new skill: roll back. Watch one hand reach forward and the other back, then both arms sweep down and back as the weight sits into the back leg.
items.go: Reach, then sweep back.

c.l: Shift forward and reach one hand ahead at chest height, the other hand low behind it.
Turn the waist and sweep both hands down and back as you sit into the back leg.
Nothing is pulled with the arms. The waist turns, and the hands follow.
Breathe out, and reach forward. Breathe in, and roll back.
Today's new form is built on this sweep.

u.l: Roll back. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: Grasp the Bird's Tail, the heart of Tai Chi. Watch four actions flow into one: ward off, roll back, press, and push.
items.go: One action at a time.

c.l: Ward off: step out and round the left arm in front. The right hand presses down by the hip.
Roll back: turn the palms and sit back, drawing the hands down past the waist.
Press: bring the right palm to the left wrist, and press forward as the weight moves forward.
Push: separate the hands, sit back, then push forward from the legs.
Out, ward off. In, roll back. Out, press.
Each action rides a shift of the weight. The arms never move alone.

u.l: Grasp the Bird's Tail, learned. Seven of twenty-four.

items.wl: Opening the Lungs. Watch the arms push out and draw in, opening the chest like a gentle accordion.
items.go: Slow, full breaths.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open. Breathe out as they push away.
Let each breath be a little deeper than the last.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: Welcome to section two. It begins with the heart of Tai Chi.
Today's two skills: Roll back, and Grasp the Bird's Tail.
Take your time today. These actions are worth learning well.
Grasp the Bird's Tail, learned. Many people take weeks to get here.
Seven of twenty-four.
Tomorrow: Push from the root, and Grasp the Bird's Tail, right. I'll see you then.

days.title: Push from the root · Bird's Tail right

items.wl: Flying Dove Spreads Its Wings. Watch the arms open wide as the weight shifts forward, then gather as it shifts back.
items.go: Your turn. Spread, and gather.

c.l: Shift forward and spread the wings wide.
Shift back and gather the hands in front of the chest.

items.wl: Painting a Rainbow. Watch how the arm sweeps overhead, and the weight follows it from side to side.
items.go: Your turn. Feet wide, knees soft.

c.l: Let one arm arc overhead, like painting the sky. The legs move first.
Breathe in as you rise, out as you arrive.

items.go: Repulse the Monkey. Step back, and push.
Grasp the Bird's Tail. Ward off, roll back, press, and push.

items.wl: A new skill: pushing from the root. Watch the power start in the back foot, travel up through the legs, and only then reach the palms.
items.go: Push from the floor.

c.l: Bow stance. Draw the palms back by the chest as you sit into the back leg.
Press the back foot into the floor. Let that push move you forward, and the palms simply travel out.
Wrists soft, elbows slightly bent. Never lock the arms.
Breathe in, sit back and gather. Breathe out, push from the root.
This is the push inside Grasp the Bird's Tail, and at the end of the form.

u.l: Pushing from the root. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: Grasp the Bird's Tail, on the right. Watch the body turn to the right first, then the same four actions flow the other way.
items.go: Turn, and begin.

c.l: Turn your waist to the right, and hold the ball with the left hand on top.
Step out to the right, and ward off with the right arm.
Roll back to the left, press forward, separate the hands, and push.
Same shapes, mirrored. Let the waist lead the turn.
Out, ward off. In, roll back. Out, press.
Strong on both sides. That's balanced Tai Chi.

u.l: Grasp the Bird's Tail on the right, learned. Eight of twenty-four.

items.wl: Side Stretch. Watch the body grow tall first, then arc gently to the side.
items.go: Tall first, then arc.

c.l: Reach up, and lean softly to one side. Breathe into the stretch.
Come back through the centre, and stretch the other side.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Day six. Today you'll feel where Tai Chi power really comes from.
Today's two skills: Push from the root, and Grasp the Bird's Tail, right.
Strong on both sides. That's the goal today.
Both sides of the Bird's Tail. Your practice is getting balanced.
Eight of twenty-four.
Tomorrow: Silk reeling, and The Tai Chi walk. I'll see you then.

days.title: Week one · silk reeling & the Tai Chi walk

items.wl: Lifting the Sky. The hands rise with the in-breath, and float down with the out-breath.
items.go: Your turn. Interlace your fingers in front of your belly.

c.l: Breathe in, and lift all the way overhead, palms to the sky.
Breathe out, and let your arms float down. A little taller with every breath.

items.wl: Flying Wild Goose. Watch the arms rise like wings as the body lifts onto the toes, then float down as the knees bend.
items.go: Your turn. Light as a bird.

c.l: Breathe in, rise, and lift the wings.
Breathe out, sink, and let the wings settle.

items.wl: A signature skill: silk reeling. Watch how the waist turns the body in a slow spiral, and the hands just ride along, like drawing silk from a cocoon.
items.go: Low horse stance, and turn slowly.

c.l: Sink into a comfortable horse stance. Let one hand circle in front of you.
The waist turns, and the hand follows the turn. Never move the hand on its own.
Draw the silk slowly. Too fast, and the thread breaks.
In, the circle rises. Out, it sinks and turns.
This is the hidden engine of every Tai Chi form.

u.l: Silk reeling. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: Next skill: the Tai Chi walk. Watch the heel touch down empty, the weight roll forward, and the back foot step through close to the standing ankle.
items.go: Heel first, slowly.

c.l: Sink a little. Step forward with the heel, keeping the weight back.
Roll the weight forward into the front foot. Turn the toes slightly out.
Draw the back foot past the standing ankle, then step forward again.
Breathe in as you step, breathe out as the weight arrives.
This walk makes Brush Knee and Wild Horse's Mane smoother.

u.l: The Tai Chi walk. Skill unlocked.

items.go: Opening Form. Rise with the in-breath, sink with the out-breath.
Wild Horse's Mane. Hold the ball, step, and part.
White Crane. Sit back, and spread the wings.
Brush Knee. Brush past the knee, push from the legs.
Play the Lute. Sit back, heel down, hold the lute.
Repulse the Monkey. Step back, and push.
Grasp the Bird's Tail. Ward off, roll back, press, and push.
Bird's Tail, right side. Ward off, roll back, press, push.

items.wl: Qi Ball. Watch the hands hold a light, floating sphere, the palms gently drawing apart and together.
items.go: Hold the ball of energy.

c.l: Draw the hands apart slowly, then bring them closer.
Notice any warmth or tingling between the palms. That is your Qi.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: One week. You've practised every single day, and that's how change happens.
Today's two skills: Silk reeling, and The Tai Chi walk.
Today ends with your longest sequence yet: eight forms in a row.
Week one, complete. Eight forms, linked into one flow.
Look back at day one. You've come a long way.
Tomorrow: The waist leads, and Single Whip. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Rolling Arms. Watch one arm roll back and up beside the ear while the other pushes forward, the waist turning between them.
items.go: Your turn. Let the arms roll like waves.

c.l: Turn the waist, and let the back hand circle up beside your ear.
Push forward as the other hand draws back. Soft and continuous.

items.wl: Broadening the Chest. Watch the arms rise in front, then open wide like unfolding wings.
items.go: Your turn. Open, and breathe.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open wide. Feel the chest expand.
Breathe out as the arms close and float down.

items.go: Grasp the Bird's Tail. Ward off, roll back, press, and push.
Bird's Tail, right side. Ward off, roll back, press, push.

items.wl: A key skill: the waist leads. Watch the feet stay still, while the waist turns and carries one palm forward, then the other.
items.go: Feet planted, turn from the centre.

c.l: Feet still, knees soft. Turn the waist, and let the palm be carried forward.
Turn back the other way. The other palm travels out.
If the arms move first, slow down. The waist is the engine, the arms are passengers.
Out as you turn and push. In as you come back through the centre.
Feel how much power comes from the turn alone.

u.l: The waist leads. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: Single Whip. Watch the right hand gather into a hook, then the body turns and steps out while the left palm opens forward, long and wide.
items.go: Hook, step, and open.

c.l: Turn to the right and form a hook: fingertips together, wrist bent, pointing down.
Turn back to the left and step out, heel first.
Shift forward into a bow stance as the left palm turns out and pushes. The hook stays behind.
In, gather and hook. Out, step and open.
Feel the opening across the chest and back.

u.l: Single Whip, learned. Nine of twenty-four.

items.wl: Opening the Lungs. Watch the arms push out and draw in, opening the chest like a gentle accordion.
items.go: Slow, full breaths.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open. Breathe out as they push away.
Let each breath be a little deeper than the last.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Week two begins. Today, we open wide.
Today's two skills: The waist leads, and Single Whip.
Feel how the turn of the waist drives everything.
Single Whip, learned. Nine of twenty-four.
Your movements are starting to come from the centre.
Tomorrow: Cloud steps, and Cloud Hands. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Separating the Clouds. Watch the hands cross in front, rise overhead, then part wide and float down.
items.go: Your turn. Cross, rise, and part.

c.l: Breathe in as the crossed hands rise overhead.
Breathe out as they part the clouds and float down.

items.wl: Bouncing the Ball. Watch one knee lift as the opposite hand rises, as if bouncing an imaginary ball.
items.go: Your turn. Light and springy.

c.l: Lift the knee, and let the hand float up with it.
Change sides. Soft bounces, steady balance.

items.go: Bird's Tail, right side. Ward off, roll back, press, push.
Single Whip. Hook the hand, step out, and open wide.

items.wl: Next: cloud steps, the footwork of Cloud Hands. Watch the feet step sideways, close, then open again, with the body at one height.
items.go: Step sideways, slowly.

c.l: Shift your weight to the right. Bring the left foot in beside it, softly.
Shift onto the left foot, then step the right foot out to the side.
The feet stay parallel. Small, quiet steps.
In as you close the feet, out as you step out.
Next, the hands join these steps.

u.l: Cloud steps. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: Wave Hands Like Clouds. Watch the hands circle in front of the face and the belly, passing each other, while the waist turns and the feet step sideways.
items.go: Hands first, then add the steps.

c.l: Upper hand at face height, lower hand at belly height. Let the waist turn them to the side.
At the side, the hands change places: the top hand floats down, the bottom hand floats up.
Now add the cloud steps. Step in as you turn one way, step out as you turn the other.
In as the hands change, out as the waist turns.
Soft wrists, heavy elbows. Effortless.

u.l: Cloud Hands, learned. Ten of twenty-four.

items.wl: Side Stretch. Watch the body grow tall first, then arc gently to the side.
items.go: Tall first, then arc.

c.l: Reach up, and lean softly to one side. Breathe into the stretch.
Come back through the centre, and stretch the other side.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: Day nine. Today, one of the most beautiful forms in Tai Chi.
Today's two skills: Cloud steps, and Cloud Hands.
First the feet, then the hands. Soft as clouds.
Cloud Hands, learned. Ten of twenty-four.
Notice how calm the body feels after drifting like a cloud.
Tomorrow: The empty step, and Single Whip from Cloud Hands. I'll see you then.

days.title: The empty step · Whip from Cloud Hands

items.wl: Broadening the Chest. Watch the arms rise in front, then open wide like unfolding wings.
items.go: Your turn. Open, and breathe.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open wide. Feel the chest expand.
Breathe out as the arms close and float down.

items.wl: Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens. Watch the palms rise overhead and press up, stretching the whole body tall.
items.go: Your turn. Interlace the fingers, and lift.

c.l: Press the palms up to the sky, and stretch tall.
Let the arms float down the sides, and repeat with the breath.

items.go: Single Whip. Hook the hand, step out, and open wide.
Cloud Hands. Let the waist turn the clouds.

items.wl: A new skill: the empty step. Watch the front foot touch down with no weight at all, like a cat testing the ground.
items.go: Sit back, and touch down lightly.

c.l: Sit all your weight into the back leg.
Touch the front heel down, lightly. If you can lift it instantly, it's empty.
Roll onto the foot slowly, step through, and try the other side.
In as the foot reaches, out as the weight follows.
High Pat on Horse uses this exact step.

u.l: The empty step. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: Single Whip again, this time growing out of Cloud Hands. Watch how the last cloud turns straight into the hook, without rising up.
items.go: Stay low through the change.

c.l: Finish the last cloud to the right, and let the right hand form the hook.
Turn and step out to the left, staying at the same height.
Open into the bow stance, the left palm turning forward.
In, gather the hook. Out, step and open.
Stay low. Tall at the crown, heavy in the legs.

u.l: Single Whip from Cloud Hands, learned. Eleven of twenty-four.

items.wl: Qi Ball. Watch the hands hold a light, floating sphere, the palms gently drawing apart and together.
items.go: Hold the ball of energy.

c.l: Draw the hands apart slowly, then bring them closer.
Notice any warmth or tingling between the palms. That is your Qi.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Day ten. Today is about lightness.
Today's two skills: The empty step, and Single Whip from Cloud Hands.
An empty step is a step you can change at any moment. That's freedom.
Eleven forms. You're nearly halfway.
The empty step will make every form lighter.
Tomorrow: Standing on one leg, and High Pat on Horse. I'll see you then.

days.title: One-leg balance · High Pat on Horse

items.wl: Bouncing on the Toes. Watch the heels rise, then drop lightly, shaking out the whole body.
items.go: Your turn. Rise, and land softly.

c.l: Rise onto the toes, tall and steady.
Let the heels drop lightly. Land like a feather.

items.wl: Twisting Arm Swings. Watch the waist turn and the arms swing loosely around the body, like empty sleeves in the wind.
items.go: Your turn. Loose arms, easy turns.

c.l: Turn from the waist, and let the arms wrap around you.
Let the heels lift a little as you turn. Loosen everything.

items.go: Cloud Hands. Let the waist turn the clouds.
Single Whip. Hook, step, and open, staying low.

items.wl: A new skill: standing on one leg. Watch the knee rise slowly while the standing leg stays soft and rooted.
items.go: Use a chair or a wall if you need one.

c.l: Shift all your weight into the left leg. Keep the knee soft.
Slowly lift the right knee, only as high as stays steady.
Lower it with control, and try the other side.
Breathe in as the knee and hand rise. Breathe out as they lower.
Balance is a skill. It grows every day you practise.

u.l: Standing on one leg. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: High Pat on Horse. Watch the back foot draw in half a step and the weight sit back, as one palm reaches forward over the top and the other settles by the waist.
items.go: Sit back, rise tall, and reach.

c.l: Draw the back foot in half a step, and sit back onto it.
The front foot becomes empty, toes resting lightly.
The right palm reaches forward at face height. The left palm turns up by your waist.
In, sit back. Out, reach forward.
Calm and tall, like patting a tall horse.

u.l: High Pat on Horse, learned. Twelve of twenty-four. You're halfway there.

items.wl: Opening the Lungs. Watch the arms push out and draw in, opening the chest like a gentle accordion.
items.go: Slow, full breaths.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open. Breathe out as they push away.
Let each breath be a little deeper than the last.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: Day eleven. Today we build balance.
Today's two skills: Standing on one leg, and High Pat on Horse.
Keep a chair or a wall nearby if you need it. There's no prize for wobbling.
Twelve of twenty-four. You're halfway through the whole form.
Halfway, in just eleven days.
Tomorrow: Right Heel Kick, and Strike the Ears with Both Fists. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Pushing Waves. Watch the weight rock forward and back as the palms push out and draw in, like a wave.
items.go: Your turn. Ride the wave.

c.l: Push forward as the weight goes forward. Draw back as it returns.
The movement starts in the legs. The hands are just the crest of the wave.

items.wl: Rowing the Boat. Watch the arms circle down, back and up, as the body bends gently forward and rises.
items.go: Your turn. Long, slow strokes.

c.l: Bend the knees as the arms row down and back.
Rise and circle the arms up. Row the whole lake with every stroke.

items.go: Single Whip. Hook, step, and open, staying low.
High Pat on Horse. Sit back, rise tall, and reach.

items.wl: Kick with the Right Heel. Watch the wrists cross in front of the chest, then the arms open as the right heel presses out, slowly.
items.go: Balance first, kick second.

c.l: Step and cross the wrists in front of your chest, weight settling into the left leg.
Lift the right knee. Open the arms out to the sides.
Press the right heel out slowly, toes up. Low and controlled beats high and shaky.
In, cross and lift. Out, open and press the heel.
Lower the foot with control, as if setting down a teacup.

u.l: Right Heel Kick, learned. Thirteen of twenty-four.

items.wl: Strike the Ears with Both Fists. Watch the hands drop beside the knee, then circle out and up into loose fists that meet in front of the head.
items.go: Step, then circle the fists.

c.l: Draw the right knee in, and let both hands settle beside it, palms up.
Step forward, heel first, as the hands drop down beside the hips.
Circle loose fists out and up, meeting at head height, as you shift forward.
In, gather by the knee. Out, step and circle.
The power comes from the bow stance, not the shoulders.

items.t: Strike the Ears with Both Fists

u.t: Strike the Ears with Both Fists
u.l: Strike the Ears, learned. Fourteen of twenty-four.

items.wl: Side Stretch. Watch the body grow tall first, then arc gently to the side.
items.go: Tall first, then arc.

c.l: Reach up, and lean softly to one side. Breathe into the stretch.
Come back through the centre, and stretch the other side.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Day twelve. Today, two strong forms.
Today's two skills: Right Heel Kick, and Strike the Ears with Both Fists.
Balance first, kick second. Always.
Two forms in one day, and both with power.
Fourteen of twenty-four.
Tomorrow: Sinking and rising, and Turn and Left Heel Kick. I'll see you then.

days.title: Sink and rise · Left Heel Kick

items.wl: Spinning Wheel. Watch the arms trace a great circle down one side, across the legs, and up overhead.
items.go: Your turn. A big, slow wheel.

c.l: Let the weight travel with the circle, from foot to foot.
Keep the circle round and unhurried. Then change direction.

items.wl: Flying Dove Spreads Its Wings. Watch the arms open wide as the weight shifts forward, then gather as it shifts back.
items.go: Your turn. Spread, and gather.

c.l: Shift forward and spread the wings wide.
Shift back and gather the hands in front of the chest.

items.go: Right Heel Kick. Cross, lift, and press the heel.

items.t: Strike the Ears with Both Fists
items.go: Strike the Ears. Circle the fists up from the legs.

items.wl: A new skill: sinking and rising. Watch the body lower into the legs, then rise smoothly, with the spine long the whole way.
items.go: Only as low as you can rise from.

c.l: Step out wide. Sink slowly, bending the knees, the spine staying long.
Scoop the hands down as you sink, and gather them as you rise.
Rise smoothly, without pushing up with a jerk.
Out as you sink. In as you rise.
This prepares you for Snake Creeps Down.

u.l: Sinking and rising. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: Turn and Kick with the Left Heel. Watch the body turn on the heel, the wrists cross, and then the left heel presses out.
items.go: Turn, settle, then kick.

c.l: Sit back, turn the front toes in, and turn your body around.
Settle into the right leg, and cross the wrists in front of the chest.
Lift the left knee, open the arms, and press the left heel out slowly.
In, turn and cross. Out, open and kick.
Both sides now. Your balance is growing.

u.l: Left Heel Kick, learned. Fifteen of twenty-four.

items.wl: Qi Ball. Watch the hands hold a light, floating sphere, the palms gently drawing apart and together.
items.go: Hold the ball of energy.

c.l: Draw the hands apart slowly, then bring them closer.
Notice any warmth or tingling between the palms. That is your Qi.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: Day thirteen. Today we prepare the legs for the low forms ahead.
Today's two skills: Sinking and rising, and Turn and Left Heel Kick.
Only as low as you can rise from. Always.
Fifteen forms. Every form of section two is yours now.
Tomorrow is a milestone day.
Tomorrow: Sinking the Qi, and Turning to look behind. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Painting a Rainbow. Watch how the arm sweeps overhead, and the weight follows it from side to side.
items.go: Your turn. Feet wide, knees soft.

c.l: Let one arm arc overhead, like painting the sky. The legs move first.
Breathe in as you rise, out as you arrive.

items.wl: Lifting the Sky. The hands rise with the in-breath, and float down with the out-breath.
items.go: Your turn. Interlace your fingers in front of your belly.

c.l: Breathe in, and lift all the way overhead, palms to the sky.
Breathe out, and let your arms float down. A little taller with every breath.

items.wl: A new skill: sinking the Qi. Watch the arms gather high above, then draw the energy down in front of the body, all the way to the belly.
items.go: Reach up, then draw it down.

c.l: Circle the arms out and up overhead, gathering the sky.
Draw the palms down in front of the face, the chest, and the belly.
Feel the weight settle into your feet. Heavy below, light above.
In, the arms rise. Out, the palms descend.
Sunk Qi makes every stance more rooted.

u.l: Sinking the Qi. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: A new skill: turning to look behind. Watch the waist turn the whole body, the arms swinging up and back as the eyes look over the shoulder to the moon.
items.go: Turn from the waist, gently.

c.l: Feet planted. Turn the waist, and let the arms swing up and back.
Look over your shoulder, toward the moon behind you.
Turn back through the centre, and try the other side.
In as you turn and look. Out as you return.
This turn begins Fair Lady Works the Shuttles.

u.l: Turning to look behind. Skill unlocked.

items.go: Opening Form. Rise with the in-breath, sink with the out-breath.
Wild Horse's Mane. Hold the ball, step, and part.
White Crane. Sit back, and spread the wings.
Brush Knee. Brush past the knee, push from the legs.
Play the Lute. Sit back, heel down, hold the lute.
Repulse the Monkey. Step back, and push.
Grasp the Bird's Tail. Ward off, roll back, press, and push.
Bird's Tail, right side. Ward off, roll back, press, push.
Single Whip. Hook the hand, step out, and open wide.
Cloud Hands. Let the waist turn the clouds.
Single Whip. Hook, step, and open, staying low.
High Pat on Horse. Sit back, rise tall, and reach.
Right Heel Kick. Cross, lift, and press the heel.

items.t: Strike the Ears with Both Fists
items.go: Strike the Ears. Circle the fists up from the legs.
Left Heel Kick. Turn, cross, and press the heel.

items.wl: Opening the Lungs. Watch the arms push out and draw in, opening the chest like a gentle accordion.
items.go: Slow, full breaths.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open. Breathe out as they push away.
Let each breath be a little deeper than the last.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Two weeks. Today is a milestone.
Today's two skills: Sinking the Qi, and Turning to look behind.
Today you'll link fifteen forms, from the Opening Form to the left heel kick.
Fifteen forms, flowing as one. Two whole sections.
Two weeks ago, you hadn't learned a single form.
Tomorrow: Snake Creeps Down, left, and Snake Creeps Down, right. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Cloud Hands in Horse Stance. Watch the legs stay rooted while the hands drift side to side like clouds.
items.go: Your turn. Sink into a horse stance.

c.l: Let the waist turn the hands from side to side.
Stay low and steady. The legs warm up while the arms float.

items.wl: Squat Swing. Watch the knees bend as the arms swing back, then the body rises onto the toes as the arms swing forward.
items.go: Your turn. Easy and rhythmic.

c.l: Sink and swing back. Rise and swing forward.
Let the legs do the work, and let the arms ride along. Feel the warmth building.

items.t: Strike the Ears with Both Fists
items.go: Strike the Ears. Circle the fists up from the legs.
Left Heel Kick. Turn, cross, and press the heel.

items.wl: Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster. Watch the body sink low over the back leg, the left hand slide forward along the inside of the leg, then rise up onto one leg.
items.go: Sink only as low as you can rise from.

c.l: Form the hook with the right hand. Sit back, and sink into the right leg.
Slide the left hand forward along the inside of the left leg, like a snake creeping through the grass.
Shift forward and rise onto the left leg, lifting the right knee and hand: the Golden Rooster.
Out as you sink. In as you rise onto one leg.
Higher is fine. Control matters more than depth.

u.l: Snake Creeps Down on the left, learned. Sixteen of twenty-four.

items.wl: Now Snake Creeps Down on the right side. Watch the same sink and rise, mirrored, with the left hand hooking behind.
items.go: Mirror it slowly.

c.l: Turn, hook the left hand, and sink into the left leg.
Slide the right hand forward along the inside of the right leg.
Rise forward onto the right leg, the left knee and hand lifting up.
Out as you sink. In as you rise.
Both sides now. Your legs are getting stronger every day.

u.l: Snake Creeps Down on the right, learned. Seventeen of twenty-four.

items.wl: Side Stretch. Watch the body grow tall first, then arc gently to the side.
items.go: Tall first, then arc.

c.l: Reach up, and lean softly to one side. Breathe into the stretch.
Come back through the centre, and stretch the other side.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: Welcome to section three. Today, we go low.
Today's two skills: Snake Creeps Down, left, and Snake Creeps Down, right.
Higher is fine. Control matters more than depth.
Snake Creeps Down, on both sides. That takes real strength.
Seventeen of twenty-four.
Tomorrow: Fair Lady Works the Shuttles, and Needle at Sea Bottom. I'll see you then.

days.title: Fair Lady & Needle at Sea Bottom

items.wl: Flying Wild Goose. Watch the arms rise like wings as the body lifts onto the toes, then float down as the knees bend.
items.go: Your turn. Light as a bird.

c.l: Breathe in, rise, and lift the wings.
Breathe out, sink, and let the wings settle.

items.wl: Separating the Clouds. Watch the hands cross in front, rise overhead, then part wide and float down.
items.go: Your turn. Cross, rise, and part.

c.l: Breathe in as the crossed hands rise overhead.
Breathe out as they part the clouds and float down.

items.go: Snake Creeps Down. Sink low, rise on one leg.
Snake Creeps Down, right side. Sink, slide, and rise.

items.wl: Fair Lady Works the Shuttles. Watch the body turn and step to the corner, one forearm rising to shield above the head, the other palm pushing forward.
items.go: Turn first, then step.

c.l: Turn, and hold the ball. Step out toward the corner, heel first.
Shift forward. One forearm rises to shield above the head, palm turned out.
The other palm pushes forward at chest height. Then turn, and repeat to the other corner.
In, turn and gather. Out, step, shield and push.
Elbows stay low. Shoulders stay down.

u.l: Fair Lady Works the Shuttles, learned. Eighteen of twenty-four.

items.wl: Needle at Sea Bottom. Watch the weight sit back into an empty step, and the right hand point down in front, as the body hinges forward from the hips.
items.go: Sit back, then hinge.

c.l: Draw the back foot in, and sit all your weight onto it.
Raise the right hand beside the ear, then point it down in front, like a needle into the sea.
Hinge from the hips, keeping the back long. Don't round the spine.
In, the hand lifts. Out, hinge and point down.
Rise slowly, without hurrying.

u.l: Needle at Sea Bottom, learned. Nineteen of twenty-four.

items.wl: Qi Ball. Watch the hands hold a light, floating sphere, the palms gently drawing apart and together.
items.go: Hold the ball of energy.

c.l: Draw the hands apart slowly, then bring them closer.
Notice any warmth or tingling between the palms. That is your Qi.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Day sixteen. Today, turning and hinging.
Today's two skills: Fair Lady Works the Shuttles, and Needle at Sea Bottom.
Turn with the waist, and the knees stay safe.
Two more forms. Nineteen of twenty-four.
Only five forms left to learn.
Tomorrow: The Tai Chi fist, and Fan Through Back. I'll see you then.

days.title: The Tai Chi fist · Fan Through Back

items.wl: Rolling Arms. Watch one arm roll back and up beside the ear while the other pushes forward, the waist turning between them.
items.go: Your turn. Let the arms roll like waves.

c.l: Turn the waist, and let the back hand circle up beside your ear.
Push forward as the other hand draws back. Soft and continuous.

items.wl: Bouncing the Ball. Watch one knee lift as the opposite hand rises, as if bouncing an imaginary ball.
items.go: Your turn. Light and springy.

c.l: Lift the knee, and let the hand float up with it.
Change sides. Soft bounces, steady balance.

items.go: Fair Lady. Turn, step, shield and push.
Needle at Sea Bottom. Sit back, and point down.

items.wl: A new skill: the Tai Chi fist. Watch the loose fist travel out from the waist, carried by a turn of the body, not by the shoulder.
items.go: Horse stance, loose fists by the waist.

c.l: Sink into a comfortable horse stance, fists resting at the waist, palms up.
Turn the waist and let one fist travel out, turning over at the end.
Draw it back as the other fist goes out. Loose fists, straight wrists.
Out, punch. In, draw back.
Next, this fist becomes Deflect, Parry and Punch.

u.l: The Tai Chi fist. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: Fan Through Back. Watch the body rise from the needle and step forward, one arm lifting to shield the head while the other palm pushes forward, opening the back like a fan.
items.go: Rise, step, and open.

c.l: Rise from the needle, both hands lifting in front of the chest.
Step forward with the left foot, heel first.
Push the left palm forward as the right forearm lifts above the head. Feel the back open.
In, rise and gather. Out, step and open.
The push and the step finish together.

u.l: Fan Through Back, learned. Twenty of twenty-four.

items.wl: Opening the Lungs. Watch the arms push out and draw in, opening the chest like a gentle accordion.
items.go: Slow, full breaths.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open. Breathe out as they push away.
Let each breath be a little deeper than the last.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: Day seventeen. Today, power and opening.
Today's two skills: The Tai Chi fist, and Fan Through Back.
Loose fists, relaxed shoulders, power from the legs.
Fan Through Back, learned. Twenty of twenty-four.
The finish line is in sight.
Tomorrow: Deflect, Parry and Punch, and Withdraw and Push. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens. Watch the palms rise overhead and press up, stretching the whole body tall.
items.go: Your turn. Interlace the fingers, and lift.

c.l: Press the palms up to the sky, and stretch tall.
Let the arms float down the sides, and repeat with the breath.

items.wl: Broadening the Chest. Watch the arms rise in front, then open wide like unfolding wings.
items.go: Your turn. Open, and breathe.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open wide. Feel the chest expand.
Breathe out as the arms close and float down.

items.go: Needle at Sea Bottom. Sit back, and point down.
Fan Through Back. Step, and open the fan.

items.wl: Turn, Deflect, Parry and Punch. Watch the fist circle down and over to deflect, the other palm parry across, then the fist punch forward from the waist.
items.go: Deflect, parry, then punch.

c.l: Turn, and let the right fist circle down and over in front of you: deflect.
Step forward, and the left palm sweeps across: parry.
Shift forward and punch the right fist out at chest height, from the waist.
In, deflect. Out, step and parry. Out, punch.
The punch arrives with the weight, not before it.

u.l: Deflect, Parry and Punch, learned. Twenty-one of twenty-four.

items.wl: Withdraw and Push. Watch the left hand slide under the right forearm, both palms draw back as the weight sits back, then push forward from the legs.
items.go: Withdraw, then push.

c.l: Slide the left hand under the right forearm, opening the fist.
Separate the hands and draw them back to the chest as you sit back.
Push both palms forward as the weight moves forward. Wrists soft.
In, sit back and withdraw. Out, push.
Push the wall away with your legs, not your arms.

u.l: Withdraw and Push, learned. Twenty-two of twenty-four.

items.wl: Side Stretch. Watch the body grow tall first, then arc gently to the side.
items.go: Tall first, then arc.

c.l: Reach up, and lean softly to one side. Breathe into the stretch.
Come back through the centre, and stretch the other side.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Day eighteen. Today, two classic forms with real power.
Today's two skills: Deflect, Parry and Punch, and Withdraw and Push.
Calm and unhurried. Power without strain.
Twenty-two forms. Only two left.
Tomorrow, you'll learn the last two forms of Tai Chi.
Tomorrow: Cross Hands, and Closing Form. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Bouncing the Ball. Watch one knee lift as the opposite hand rises, as if bouncing an imaginary ball.
items.go: Your turn. Light and springy.

c.l: Lift the knee, and let the hand float up with it.
Change sides. Soft bounces, steady balance.

items.wl: Pushing Waves. Watch the weight rock forward and back as the palms push out and draw in, like a wave.
items.go: Your turn. Ride the wave.

c.l: Push forward as the weight goes forward. Draw back as it returns.
The movement starts in the legs. The hands are just the crest of the wave.

items.go: Deflect, Parry and Punch. Punch from the waist.
Withdraw and Push. Sit back, and push from the legs.

items.wl: Cross Hands. Watch the body turn, the arms circle out and down, then cross at the wrists in front of the chest as the feet come parallel.
items.go: Circle, and cross.

c.l: Turn the front toes in, and open the arms out to the sides.
Circle the hands down and in, crossing the wrists, right hand outside.
Bring the feet parallel, shoulder-width, and rise gently with the wrists crossed.
In, open. Out, circle down. In, rise and cross.
Feel the whole form gathering to its centre.

u.l: Cross Hands, learned. Twenty-three of twenty-four.

items.wl: The Closing Form. Watch the crossed hands turn and separate, then float down to the sides as the body rises, perfectly calm.
items.go: Slowly, and still.

c.l: Turn the palms down, and let the crossed hands separate to shoulder width.
Lower the hands slowly in front of you, all the way to your sides.
Bring the left foot in beside the right. Stand quietly.
Breathe out, and let the hands float down.
Every form you've learned begins and ends here.

u.l: Closing Form, learned. All twenty-four forms. You now know the complete Tai Chi form.

items.wl: Qi Ball. Watch the hands hold a light, floating sphere, the palms gently drawing apart and together.
items.go: Hold the ball of energy.

c.l: Draw the hands apart slowly, then bring them closer.
Notice any warmth or tingling between the palms. That is your Qi.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: Day nineteen. Today, you learn the last two forms.
Today's two skills: Cross Hands, and Closing Form.
By the end of today, you will know the complete twenty-four form.
All twenty-four forms. You've learned the complete Tai Chi form.
Take a moment to feel proud of that.
Tomorrow: Gathering to the centre, and Stretching in two directions. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Rowing the Boat. Watch the arms circle down, back and up, as the body bends gently forward and rises.
items.go: Your turn. Long, slow strokes.

c.l: Bend the knees as the arms row down and back.
Rise and circle the arms up. Row the whole lake with every stroke.

items.wl: Painting a Rainbow. Watch how the arm sweeps overhead, and the weight follows it from side to side.
items.go: Your turn. Feet wide, knees soft.

c.l: Let one arm arc overhead, like painting the sky. The legs move first.
Breathe in as you rise, out as you arrive.

items.wl: A new skill: gathering to the centre. Watch the arms open wide, then gather slowly back toward the belly, as if collecting all the movement of the day.
items.go: Open wide, then gather.

c.l: Open the arms wide to the sides, chest soft.
Gather slowly toward the belly, as if hugging a large ball of air.
Rest the hands near the navel, and feel the warmth there.
In as the arms open. Out as they gather in.
Every section of the form ends by gathering like this.

u.l: Gathering to the centre. Skill unlocked.

items.wl: A new skill: stretching in two directions. Watch one palm press up to the sky while the other presses down to the earth, opening the whole body.
items.go: Press up, press down.

c.l: Lift one palm overhead, pressing up, while the other presses down by the hip.
Feel the stretch through the side of the body, from palm to palm.
Change sides slowly, passing the hands in front of the chest.
In as the hands pass. Out as they press apart.
This two-way stretch lives inside White Crane and Fan Through Back.

u.l: Stretching in two directions. Skill unlocked.

items.go: Snake Creeps Down. Sink low, rise on one leg.
Snake Creeps Down, right side. Sink, slide, and rise.
Fair Lady. Turn, step, shield and push.
Needle at Sea Bottom. Sit back, and point down.
Fan Through Back. Step, and open the fan.
Deflect, Parry and Punch. Punch from the waist.
Withdraw and Push. Sit back, and push from the legs.
Cross Hands. Open, circle down, and cross.
Closing Form. The hands float down. Stand in stillness.

items.wl: Opening the Lungs. Watch the arms push out and draw in, opening the chest like a gentle accordion.
items.go: Slow, full breaths.

c.l: Breathe in as the arms open. Breathe out as they push away.
Let each breath be a little deeper than the last.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Day twenty. Today, section three comes together.
Today's two skills: Gathering to the centre, and Stretching in two directions.
From the snake to stillness: nine forms in one flow.
Section three, linked. All three sections are yours.
Now we make them beautiful.
Tomorrow: Lift the crown, and Sink the shoulders, drop the elbows. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Twisting Arm Swings. Watch the waist turn and the arms swing loosely around the body, like empty sleeves in the wind.
items.go: Your turn. Loose arms, easy turns.

c.l: Turn from the waist, and let the arms wrap around you.
Let the heels lift a little as you turn. Loosen everything.

items.wl: Lifting the Sky. The hands rise with the in-breath, and float down with the out-breath.
items.go: Your turn. Interlace your fingers in front of your belly.

c.l: Breathe in, and lift all the way overhead, palms to the sky.
Breathe out, and let your arms float down. A little taller with every breath.

items.go: Opening Form. Rise with the in-breath, sink with the out-breath.
Wild Horse's Mane. Hold the ball, step, and part.

items.wl: A Tai Chi essential: lift the crown. Watch how the head floats up, as if held by a thread, while the body below relaxes downward.
items.go: Stand tall, and let the thread lift you.

c.l: Imagine a thread lifting the crown of your head, gently.
Tuck the chin slightly. The back of the neck grows long.
Now let everything below the thread relax down: shoulders, chest, belly.
As you sit back, the head stays lifted.
A lifted crown makes every form lighter.

u.l: Lift the crown. Essential unlocked.

items.go: Brush Knee. Brush past the knee, push from the legs.

items.wl: An essential: sink the shoulders and drop the elbows. Watch the arms float, while the shoulders stay low and the elbows hang heavy.
items.go: Let the shoulders melt.

c.l: Lift the shoulders up to your ears, then let them drop. Stay there.
Let the elbows feel heavy, as if small weights hang from them.
The arms float, but the shoulders never rise with them.
As the hands rise, check: are the shoulders still down?
Relaxed shoulders let the power flow through.

items.t: Sink the shoulders, drop the elbows

u.t: Sink the shoulders, drop the elbows
u.l: Sink the shoulders, drop the elbows. Essential unlocked.

items.go: Repulse the Monkey. Step back, and push.

items.wl: Embracing the Centre. Watch the arms gather a little space toward the belly, and rest there.
items.go: Gather, and rest.

c.l: Gather the arms slowly toward the belly.
Let the breath settle low and quiet.

items.wl: Last one. One hand on your chest, one on your belly. Simply breathe.
items.go: Close your eyes, if you like.

c.l: Breathe in through your nose, and let the belly expand.
Breathe out slowly. Notice how your body feels now.

lines: Three weeks. Now the real art begins: the Tai Chi essentials.
Today's two skills: Lift the crown, and Sink the shoulders, drop the elbows.
These are the principles masters practise for a lifetime.
Two essentials, and section one flowing with them.
Feel how much lighter the forms already look.
Tomorrow: The waist is the axle, and Upper and lower together. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Flying Dove Spreads Its Wings. Watch the arms open wide as the weight shifts forward, then gather as it shifts back.
items.go: Your turn. Spread, and gather.

c.l: Shift forward and spread the wings wide.
Shift back and gather the hands in front of the chest.

items.wl: Spinning Wheel. Watch the arms trace a great circle down one side, across the legs, and up overhead.
items.go: Your turn. A big, slow wheel.

c.l: Let the weight travel with the circle, from foot to foot.
Keep the circle round and unhurried. Then change direction.

items.wl: An essential: upper and lower move as one. Watch in Brush Knee how the hand and the foot arrive at exactly the same moment.
items.go: Slowly, and listen for the moment of arrival.

c.l: Step and brush. As the weight arrives, the push arrives.
If the hand finishes early, slow it down to wait for the legs.
Feet, waist and hands, all finishing together.
Breathe out as everything arrives at once.
This is called whole-body power.

u.l: Upper and lower together. Essential unlocked.

items.go: Opening Form. Rise with the in-breath, sink with the out-breath.
Grasp the Bird's Tail. Ward off, roll back, press, and push.
Bird's Tail, right side. Ward off, roll back, press, push.
Single Whip. Hook the hand, step out, and open wide.

items.wl: An essential: the waist is the axle. Watch how every turn in Cloud Hands comes from the waist, like a wheel turning on its axle.
items.go: Hands still, turn only the waist.

c.l: Rest the hands lightly on the belly. Turn the waist left and right.
The hips turn, and the knees stay over the toes.
Now let the hands float up, and keep turning from the centre.
If the hands move without the waist, slow down.
The axle stays upright. No leaning.

u.l: The waist is the axle. Essential unlocked.

items.go: Single Whip. Hook, step, and open, staying low.
High Pat on Horse. Sit back, rise tall, and reach.
Right Heel Kick. Cross, lift, and press the heel.

items.t: Strike the Ears with Both Fists
items.go: Strike the Ears. Circle the fists up from the legs.
Left Heel Kick. Turn, cross, and press the heel.

items.wl: Side Stretch. Watch the body grow tall first, then arc gently to the side.
items.go: Tall first, then arc.

c.l: Reach up, and lean softly to one side. Breathe into the stretch.
Come back through the centre, and stretch the other side.

items.wl: Let's settle. The palms rise with the in-breath, turn over, and press down with the out-breath.
items.go: Slow and quiet.

c.l: Press down slowly, like pressing through still water.
Let everything become calm and still, like a quiet lake.

lines: Day twenty-two. Today, power from the centre.
Today's two skills: The waist is the axle, and Upper and lower together.
When the waist turns and the whole body moves together, Tai Chi comes alive.
Section two, with a turning waist and a unified body.
Your Tai Chi is starting to look like real Tai Chi.
Tomorrow: Even height, and Mind, not force. I'll see you then.

items.wl: Separating the Clouds. Watch the hands cross in front, rise overhead, then part wide and float down.
items.go: Your turn. Cross, rise, and part.

c.l: Breathe in as the crossed hands rise overhead.
Breathe out as they part the clouds and float down.

items.wl: Cloud Hands in Horse Stance. Watch the legs stay rooted while the hands drift side to side like clouds.
items.go: Your turn. Sink into a horse stance.

c.l: Let the waist turn the hands from side to side.
Stay low and steady. The legs warm up while the arms float.

items.wl: An essential: even height. Watch Wild Horse's Mane glide forward without the head rising or falling.
items.go: Choose a height, and keep it.

c.l: Sink a little, and imagine your head sliding along a low ceiling.
As you step and shift, the knees stay bent.
If your head bobs up, sink back to your chosen height.
Breathe out as you part the mane, staying level.
Even height makes the form look effortless.

u.l: Even height. Essential unlocked.

items.go: Snake Creeps Down. Sink low, rise on one leg.

plans.title: Morning Energy Boost
plans.subtitle: 10 min · Qigong & Tai Chi wake-up
plans.description: Shake loose, open the chest, paint the rainbow and lift the heavens, then step through three Tai Chi forms and finish bouncing on the toes. A standing wake-up that leaves you warm, loose and clear.

plans.title: Evening Relax Stretch
plans.subtitle: 7 min · unwind before sleep
plans.description: Standing twists, side bends and long hip, thigh and shoulder stretches, finished with slow belly breathing to let the day go.

plans.title: Desk Break Routine
plans.subtitle: 5 min · stand and reset
plans.description: Step away from the screen for standing Qigong: swing the stiffness out, open the chest, lengthen the sides, tap the lower back and clear your head in five minutes.

plans.title: 7-Day Step & Stretch
plans.subtitle: 7 days · ease back into moving
plans.description: Seven short days of easy indoor walking steps, each finished with full-body standing stretches. A gentle way to build the habit before a longer course.

plans.title: 7-Day Full-Body Fusion
plans.subtitle: 7 days · five styles, one week
plans.description: Try everything TaiChi Flow teaches in a single week: Tai Chi, walking cardio, Wall Pilates, Shibashi, intervals, a wall core day and the Eight Brocades. Find the style you love, then follow its full course.

plans.title: Balance & Breath Flow
plans.subtitle: 12 min · steady on one leg
plans.description: Hip circles and weight shifts into White Crane, Golden Rooster and Repulse the Monkey, then Cloud Hands and a long, slow breath.

plans.title: Flow & Power Basics
plans.subtitle: 12 min · rooted strength, soft hands
plans.description: Bow stances and pushing forms from the 24-form — Wild Horse’s Mane, Brush Knee, Grasp the Bird’s Tail, Single Whip and Withdraw and Push.

plans.title: Tai Chi Foundations
plans.subtitle: 21 days · learn the classic 24-form
plans.description: Learn the Yang-style 24-form — the Tai Chi sequence practised in parks around the world — one or two postures a day. Every lesson warms you up, reviews yesterday, teaches the new form slowly, then practises the forms you already know, each one once. Weekly sections build to day 21, when you move through all 24 forms on your own.

items.g: Today, build your base before lifting the arms. Feel the feet and keep the knees soft.
Today, place the heel before shifting into Wild Horse. Let your waist guide the hands.
Today, find a stable support leg in White Crane. Lift the arms without raising the shoulders.
Today, coordinate the brush and push with your step. Let the weight settle before reaching.
Today, shorten the stance for Play the Lute. Keep the front foot light and the elbows soft.
Today, learn to step back without leaning. Check the space behind you and place each foot carefully.
Today, rehearse section one once. Keep the pace steady and reset between demonstrations when needed.
Today, explore the separate actions of Grasp the Bird's Tail. Connect each action to a controlled weight shift.

days.title: Bird’s Tail to the right & Single Whip

items.g: Today, mirror Grasp the Bird's Tail to the right, then open into Single Whip with relaxed elbows. Keep the chest soft.
Today, let the waist carry Cloud Hands. Keep one steady height as the hands drift across.

days.title: Single Whip from Cloud Hands & High Pat

items.g: Today, let Single Whip grow out of the last Cloud Hands, then settle into High Pat on Horse with a light front foot.
Today, choose a low right heel kick. Stabilise the standing leg before extending the foot.

days.title: Strike the Ears & the left heel kick

items.g: Today, regain your balance between Strike the Ears and the left kick. Keep the kick height comfortable.
Today, connect the first two sections in order. Finish a weight shift before starting the next posture.
Today, learn the low stance and the rise on each side. Depth matters less than a controlled return to balance.
Today, prepare each turn in Fair Lady before stepping. Avoid twisting a planted knee.

days.title: Needle at Sea Bottom & Fan Through Back

items.g: Today, hinge comfortably for Needle, then rise into Fan. Keep both actions smooth and unforced.

Today, learn the closing section. Soften the push, gather the hands, and finish with steady feet.
Today, rehearse section three once. Sink and rise on each side with control before Fair Lady.
Today, practise all twenty-four forms once, in order. Prioritise alignment and pause to reset whenever needed.

plans.title: Tai Chi Warrior
plans.subtitle: 30 days · expert martial Tai Chi with Master Wei
plans.description: The hardest course in TaiChi Flow, taught by Master Wei. Thirty days of real martial Tai Chi: iron stances and standing post, silk-reeling spirals, all eight gates with push hands, explosive fa jin strikes, kicks, footwork and combat flows. Holds grow from one minute to five, every day adds a new skill or combat principle, and two tests mark your progress before the master's test on day 30. For practitioners with a solid base who want Tai Chi as a martial art.

items.wl: Rise and Sink. Watch the knees and the arms work together: the arms float up as the legs rise, and sink as the knees bend.
items.go: Your turn. Soft knees. Let the arms ride on the legs.

c.l: The legs lift the arms. The shoulders never do the work.
Sink a little deeper every time, and feel the thighs wake up.
This is how power will travel later: from the ground, through the body, out of the hands.

items.wl: Crane Knee Raises. Arms spread like wings, one knee drives up high, the foot lands quietly, then the other knee.
items.go: Your turn. Arms out at shoulder height. Drive the knee up, and land without a sound.

c.l: The standing leg stays tall and steady. The body does not lean back.
Knee to hip height or higher. Height comes with time, control comes first.
Exhale on each lift. Every landing silent.

items.wl: Standing Post, Zhan Zhuang. Knees soft, arms round as if hugging a great tree. Then complete stillness.
items.go: Sink a little, round the arms, and hold.

c.l: Shoulders heavy, elbows heavy, the crown of the head floating up.
Your arms will want to drop. Keep them round, and breathe into the belly.
Stillness outside, movement inside. This is where internal strength is built.

u.l: Standing post unlocked. Masters stand like this for an hour. Every minute counts.

items.wl: Iron Horse Hold. Feet wide, thighs low, back straight, arms round. I do not move.
items.go: Feet twice shoulder-width. Sink as low as you can hold with a straight back.

c.l: Knees push out over the toes. The tailbone drops straight down.
When the legs shake, breathe slower. The shaking is the old weakness leaving.
A fighter with a weak stance has nothing. A fighter with a strong stance cannot be moved.

u.l: Iron Horse unlocked. From today, your legs are your foundation.

items.wl: Horse Stance Punches. Low stance, fists at the waist. One fist strikes as the other snaps back.
items.go: Sink into the horse. Fists at the waist.

c.l: The returning fist is as fast as the striking fist. That is where the power comes from.
Twist the fist at the very end, and exhale sharply with each punch.
Stay low. If the thighs burn, you are doing it right.

items.wl: Dantian Breathing. Palms over the lower belly, knees soft, eyes half closed. Every breath sinks low.
items.go: Palms on the belly. Breathe low and slow.

c.l: Breathe in through the nose and let the belly expand into your palms.
Breathe out slowly. Let the shoulders, the chest and the mind settle.
Gather the energy of today's training below the navel. Keep it there.

Today you learn Standing Post and Iron Horse Hold.
This is not exercise for relaxation. This is the path of a fighter. It starts with a root no one can move.
You stood when your legs wanted to quit. That is day one of a fighter.
